title: Firefox
summary: Firefox is a free and open-source web browser developed by the Mozilla Foundation and its subsidiary, the Mozilla Corporation. It uses the Gecko rendering engine to display web pages and incorporates Quantum technology to promote parallelism and a more intuitive user interface. The browser features tabbed browsing, full-screen mode, spell checking, incremental search, smart bookmarks, drag-and-drop downloading, a download manager, user profile management, and private browsing. It is available across Windows, macOS, Linux, Android, and iOS platforms.
